name: web-lilac-neo-brutalist-developer-portfolio-hero
title: Developer portfolio hero with hard grid lines, marquee and sticker portrait
whatItIs: On a lilac background sit a desktop and mobile site. A ticking marquee strip says 'Subscribe to my newsletter', the header is boxed by black lines, the hero has a friendly headline with the word 'realities' highlighted in a tilted lime label, and a monochrome portrait sits in a pink shape with code and tool stickers.
whatItMeans: Confident, quirky and approachable, with the grid giving it a raw, blueprint feel.
techniques: Frame every section with hard black lines to create a visible grid.
Run a marquee ticker at the top for a promo message.
Highlight one word in a tilted label like a sticker.
Place a greyscale portrait in a colourful hex shape ringed by tool icons.
bestFor: Startups wanting a playful brutalist vibe

vocabulary.definition: A scrolling text band across the top or bottom.
A word on a rotated colour block.
A black and white portrait against colour.
